title: AnalogIO Output
text: Receive and log transitions on capture input pin or configure auxiliary pulse width modulator, 4 inputs, 4 outputs, {Time-Stamp counter data type} sets Data type of counter; {Operating mode} selects eCAP, {eCAPx pin} selects capture unit, {Counter phase offset value (0 ~ 4294967295)} sets the time base for event captures, {Enable counter Sync-In mode} enables TSCTR counter to load from CTRPHS, {Enable software-forced counter synchronizing input} sets the synchronize one or more eCAP time bases, {Sync output selection} sets the synchronize eCAP counter with other eCAP counters, {Sample time} sets the frequency at which block reads input pin, {Event prescaler (integer from 0 to 31)} sets the prescales input signal in multiples, {Enable high resolution capture} selects to enable high resolution capture or HRCAP, {Enable continuous calibration mode} selects to enable continuous calibration, {Calibration period in seconds} sets the calibration period, {Select mode control} sets the mode of capture, {Enable One-Shot rearming control via input port} sets the re-arms a One-Shot capture sequence, {Stop value after} sets the number of capture events after which capture stops Capture, {Enable reset counter after capture event # time-stamp} sets the resets counter after capture event, {Select capture event # polarity} sets the start capture event on rising edge or falling edge Rising, {Output type} selects output type for eCAP HRCLK/SYSCLK, {Enable capture event status flag output} sets the output capture event status, {Capture flag data type} sets the data type of output port, {Enable overflow status flag output} sets the output status of elements of FIFO buffer, {Overflow flag data type} sets the data type of output port, {Waveform period units} sets the units for measuring waveform period, {Waveform period source} sets the source from which waveform period value is obtained Specify via, {Waveform period} sets the period of PWM waveform, {Duty cycle units} sets the units for measuring duty, {Duty cycle source} sets the source from which duty cycle for PWM waveform is obtained Specify via, {Duty cycle} sets the ratio of PWM waveform pulse duration to PWM waveform, {Output polarity select} sets the active level for output, {Post interrupt on capture event #} sets the interrupt source to capture event, {Post interrupt on counter overflow} sets the trigger interrupt on counter overflow, {Post interrupt on counter equal period match} sets the post interrupt when counter equals period and {Post interrupt on counter equal compare match} sets the post interrupt when counter equals compare. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Operating mode
params.values: Select eCAP or APWM mode eCAP (default) | APWM

params.name: Counter phase offset value (0 ~ 4294967295)
params.values: Time base for event captures 0 (default) | integer in [0 4294967295]

params.name: Sample time
